conclusions: All12 generated cases match independent original CPU output bits, including row eligibility, exceptional or scale-range fallback, deliberately halfword-aligned input, guards and immutability. K16/272/2048/4096 widths are covered.

limitations: This component loads captured tensors, not the model, and produces no inference tokens.

Timing includes row preparation and any weight transpose, with one warmup and one timed sequence per variant. Allocation, upload, CPU candidate collection and safety downloads are excluded. Candidate order is common and sorted; product scheduling and complete TTFT still require real measurements.
